back_pod_base.material: PETG white/light grey (reflects sunlight, runs cooler)
back_pod_base.note: PMB-H (M2×6 ×4) + 104050 battery (40.6 mm wide battery pocket + crush ribs; double-sided foam tape on the floor)

back_pod_lid.note: M2×8 self-tapping ×4; a strip of 2 mm foam under each of the two hold-down ribs clamps the battery

webbing_hook.note: ×2 on the back of the back pod; M2×6 self-tapping screws driven from inside the pod

chest_pod_base.note: LIB (bottom, M2×6 ×2) + BITalino Core B (top, four corner standoffs + two end stops)

chest_pod_lid.note: M2×8 self-tapping ×4; 2 mm foam under the two hold-down ribs presses on Core B's header row

panel_shoe_TR.note: Panel shoe, top right (wearer's left/right); webbing face to panel back 42.0 mm; hangs on webbing A

panel_shoe_TL.note: Panel shoe, top left (wearer's left/right); webbing face to panel back 42.0 mm; hangs on webbing A

panel_shoe_BR.note: Panel shoe, bottom right (wearer's left/right); webbing face to panel back 42.6 mm; hangs on webbing B

panel_shoe_BL.note: Panel shoe, bottom left (wearer's left/right); webbing face to panel back 42.6 mm; hangs on webbing B

panel_shoe_TM.note: Panel shoe, top middle (wearer's left/right); webbing face to panel back 27.4 mm; hangs on webbing A

panel_shoe_BM.note: Panel shoe, bottom middle (wearer's left/right); webbing face to panel back 20.2 mm; hangs on webbing B

ref1_holder.note: Clips onto the middle of the panel's left short edge; 40.6 × 28.6 pocket for the AK 40×28 reference cell, foam tape underneath brings it flush with the glass

ref2_holder.note: Left shoulder; 24.1° wedge levels the reference cell; 40.6 × 28.6 pocket; hook-side Velcro on the base

c_case_base.note: C: BITalino Board (official 108 × 65) + 523450; board-edge stops + battery end stops; ECG lead plugs in through the left-side window

c_case_lid.note: M2×8 ×4; 4 press posts (2 mm foam on each) hold down the board's two side rails; a flexure button actuates BTN

ear_clip_pulsesensor.note: PulseSensor ear clip for A (left earlobe); 0.5 mm foam inside the jaws

stand_base.note: Panel test stand base, 0–90° in 15° steps, M4×25 + wing nut ×2

stand_cradle.note: U-channel gripping the panel's short edge; on the bench REF1 clips to the middle of the panel's top long edge
